retrieval_skill.name: layered_event_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Decompose event-driven forecasting research into future-driver, latent-process, observation, and regime layers so genuine demand changes are distinguished from measurement artifacts and recovery behavior.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When a forecast window overlaps a known external event and available reports may mix physical effects with telemetry or data-pipeline anomalies.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search separately for event timing and duration, operational evidence of the underlying process, measurement-system changes or latency, and historical post-event normalization; use progressively narrower queries that combine the event type, monitored variable, interval, and anomaly mechanism.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Retain only claims supported by attributable sources and verify that each claim refers to the forecast-relevant time window and correct mechanism layer; do not treat recorded magnitude as true latent magnitude when observation anomalies are documented, and preserve exact-quote and provenance requirements.
